title: Switching location reloads the page with the same terms and counts
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure you are also enrolled at a second location, location B.
  • Make sure the shop's own term A, due 14 days after the invoice date, is the default and is held by 2 customers.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Write down every row's name, Customers count and Vendors count, and which row has the Default tag.
  2. Switch location to location B with the location switcher at the top right.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Term A shows the Default tag and 2 customers.

Step 2:

  • The page reloads and shows exactly the same rows in the same order, with the same Customers and Vendors counts and the Default tag still on term A.
  • The terms and the default belong to the whole organization, not to a location.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list)

  • S1-R16: “The page is organization-wide. Switching location while on the page reloads it with the same terms, counts and default.”
  • Key Decisions: “One default and one term list per organization, shared by customers and vendors.”
  • Out of Scope: “Per-location or per-work-type default terms. 2 insights. One default per organization.”
